title: Edge history
description: Readings stored by the historian from the Sparkplug messages on the broker. Times are measurement times, so readings replayed from the gateway outbox fill outage gaps.

list.name: node
list.label: Gateway
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT node FROM device_events ORDER BY 1

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device FROM device_events WHERE device <> '' AND node IN ($node) ORDER BY 1

list.name: metric
list.label: Metric
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT name FROM metric_catalog WHERE node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Every device the historian has seen. Click a device to open its own dashboard (one panel per metric, generated from the device registry).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.device AS "Device", d.node AS "Gateway",
  CASE WHEN NOT d.in_registry THEN 'Removed' WHEN s.kind = 'DBIRTH' THEN 'Online' ELSE 'Offline' END AS "Status",
  (SELECT extract(epoch FROM max(r.time)) * 1000 FROM readings r WHERE r.node = d.node AND r.device = d.device AND r.time > now() - INTERVAL '30 days') AS "Last reading",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM metric_catalog m WHERE m.node = d.node AND m.device = d.device AND (m.in_registry OR NOT d.in_registry)) AS "Metrics",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM readings r WHERE r.node = d.node AND r.device = d.device AND $__timeFilter(r.time) AND r.quality <> 'good') AS "Bad in range",
  d.uid
FROM device_catalog d
-- Latest lifecycle event for the device: its own birth or death, or its gateway's death.
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT e.kind FROM device_events e
  WHERE e.node = d.node AND ((e.device = d.device AND e.kind IN ('DBIRTH', 'DDEATH')) OR (e.device = '' AND e.kind = 'NDEATH'))
  ORDER BY e.time DESC, e.event_order DESC LIMIT 1
) s ON true
WHERE d.node IN ($node) AND d.device IN ($device)
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Readings
panels.description: Average per interval. Up to 1 day it reads the raw readings; longer ranges read the 1-minute rollups.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), device || ' · ' || c.name AS metric, avg(value) AS value
FROM readings JOIN metric_catalog c USING (node, device, metric)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND c.name IN ($metric)
  AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= INTERVAL '1 day'
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval), device || ' · ' || c.name AS metric, sum(avg * samples) / nullif(sum(samples), 0) AS value
FROM readings_1m JOIN metric_catalog c USING (node, device, metric)
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND c.name IN ($metric)
  AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > INTERVAL '1 day'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH latest_sample AS (
  SELECT node, device, MAX(time) AS time
  FROM readings
  WHERE time > now() - INTERVAL '1 day'
    AND node IN ($node)
    AND device IN ($device)
  GROUP BY node, device
)
SELECT r.time, r.device || ' · ' || c.name || CASE r.quality WHEN 'bad' THEN ' [Bad]' WHEN 'stale' THEN ' [Stale]' ELSE '' END AS metric, r.value
FROM readings r
JOIN latest_sample s USING (node, device, time)
JOIN metric_catalog c USING (node, device, metric)
WHERE c.name IN ($metric)
ORDER BY r.time ASC, metric

panels.title: Bad or stale readings
panels.description: Readings in the selected range whose quality is not good (device unreachable, invalid value).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "bad readings"
FROM readings JOIN metric_catalog c USING (node, device, metric)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND quality <> 'good'
  AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND c.name IN ($metric)

panels.title: Replayed device samples
panels.description: Unique device samples received as historical, counted once across metrics and retries. Filtered by original measurement time and selected devices/metrics.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT (node, device, device_seq, time)) AS replayed
FROM readings JOIN metric_catalog c USING (node, device, metric)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND historical
  AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND c.name IN ($metric)

SELECT count(*) AS readings
FROM readings JOIN metric_catalog c USING (node, device, metric)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND c.name IN ($metric)

panels.title: Device online / offline
panels.description: From the Sparkplug births and deaths: DBIRTH = online; DDEATH, or the gateway's NDEATH = offline.

targets.rawSql:
WITH devices AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT node, device FROM device_events WHERE device <> ''
), events AS (
  SELECT time, node, device, kind, event_order FROM device_events WHERE device <> ''
  UNION ALL
  -- A gateway death takes all of its devices offline.
  SELECT e.time, d.node, d.device, e.kind, e.event_order FROM device_events e JOIN devices d USING (node) WHERE e.kind = 'NDEATH'
), states AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (time, node, device) time, node, device, CASE WHEN kind = 'DBIRTH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value
  FROM events
  WHERE node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND time <= $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY time, node, device, event_order DESC
)
SELECT time, device AS metric, value FROM states
UNION ALL
-- Extend each last observed state to the range end, including Offline.
SELECT $__timeTo() AS time, device AS metric, value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node, device) time, node, device, value
  FROM states ORDER BY node, device, time DESC
) latest
WHERE time < $__timeTo()
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Live vs replayed readings
panels.description: Readings per interval by measurement time. Replayed readings fill the period the broker was unreachable.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT historical) AS live, count(*) FILTER (WHERE historical) AS replayed
FROM readings JOIN metric_catalog c USING (node, device, metric)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND c.name IN ($metric)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT time, device, c.name AS metric, quality
FROM readings JOIN metric_catalog c USING (node, device, metric)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND quality <> 'good'
  AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND c.name IN ($metric)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 50
